facts.business: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd provides SaaS solutions for the travel and hospitality industry, connecting demand generation, distribution, pricing, and guest engagement through an AI operating system, strengthened by the acquisition of Sojern and its travel intent data platform.

guidance_or_targets.statement: FY 2025-26 revenue crossing Rs 1,800 crores and an annualized run rate of Rs 2,850 crores
Achieved USD 15 million in annualized cost synergies by Q4 FY 2025-26, ahead of Phase I target
Repaid USD 31.5 million of acquisition-related debt, over 25% of original loan, on track to be debt-free by FY 2027-28

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and trade fragmentation weighing on global economic recovery
Rising trade tensions, policy shifts, and heightened uncertainty posing challenges to global economic recovery
Integration risks from unifying technology platforms, harmonizing teams across continents, rationalizing overlapping products, and changing work processes post-Sojern acquisition
